# A bill applying two splits that are already on its payable and are the
# wrong way round for a payment.
#
# The two −60.00 and −40.00 splits sit on the payable already, so the payment
# does not move them; it claims them where they are. That is the arm the sign
# check did not cover — it read only the splits about to move.
#
# Every other check passes: neither split is in a lot, neither is another
# owner's, neither settles another record, and 60.00 and 40.00 come to the
# 100.00 the bill owes.
#
# What this fixture produces: a refusal, with both splits still loose.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
bill "BILL-REFUND-AP"
  vendor_id: "V-US"
  currency: USD
  date_opened: 2026-03-24
  entry:
    date: 2026-03-24
    description: "Supplies"
    account: "Expenses:Supplies:USD"
    quantity: 1
    price: 100
    taxable: false
  posted:
    date: 2026-03-24
    due: 2026-04-24
    ap_account: "Liabilities:Accounts Payable USD"
    memo: "Bill BILL-REFUND-AP"
    accumulate: true
  payment:
    date: 2026-03-24
    amount: 100
    account: "Assets:Bank:USD"
    Transaction "1a2b3c4d5e6f708192a3b4c5d6e7f809"
      PaymentSplit "3c4d5e6f708192a3b4c5d6e7f8091a2b"
      PaymentSplit "4d5e6f708192a3b4c5d6e7f8091a2b3c"
